texts.value: Dimer of identical or non-identical chains of class I alcohol dehydrogenase: ADH1A, ADH1B, and ADH1C
Two main alleles are known, ADH3*1 or gamma-1 has Arg-272/Ile-350 while ADH3*2 or gamma-2 has Gln-272/Val-350. ADH3*1 is associated with a fast rate of ethanol oxidation and ADH3*2 with a slow rate
There are 7 different ADH's isozymes in human: three belong to class-I: ADH1A, ADH1B, and ADH1C, one to class-II: ADH4, one to class-III: ADH5, one to class-IV: ADH7 and one to class-V: ADH6
Belongs to the zinc-containing alcohol dehydrogenase family
